## Problem

`bedrock-spend-cap` can enforce on a spend figure that includes static seed rates or `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`, but the handler has no provenance flag telling consumers that the figure is partly estimated. That capability was cut from `3083-ada3` so the empirical-rate fix can stay focused.

## Current code facts

Line numbers below are read from `origin/main` at commit `1f338f2c57e7235ac9410829d685e5ea249f0b8c`, which is the tip after `cfe0-4b2b-e02d-4df7` landed. An earlier revision of this plan cited pre-`cfe0` line numbers and described a return shape `cfe0` has since replaced; this section supersedes it.

`_rate_for()` at `infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/handler.py:227-275` returns a bare `float`. Its 4 resolution paths are the exact empirical match at lines 262-264, the seed match at lines 266-268, the input-derived empirical rate at lines 270-272, and the fail-closed fallback `return UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K * mult` at lines 274-275. The caller receives one number and cannot tell which path produced it.

`_metered_spend()` at `handler.py:306-371` accumulates `total += units_1k * _rate_for(model_id, metric_name, rates)` at line 365. It does **not** return a bare float: `cfe0` changed it to return a frozen dataclass. `MeteredSpend` is defined at `handler.py:288-291` with the fields `total`, `degraded` and `failures`, alongside `MeteredFailure` at `handler.py:282-285`. The success return is `MeteredSpend(total=total, degraded=bool(failures), failures=tuple(failures))` at line 371, and the unavailable path still returns `None` at lines 367-368. There is no accumulator for rate-source provenance.

`handler()` derives `metered_total = None if metered is None else metered.total` at line 533 and uses it for the near-threshold CE-poll arithmetic at 534-535, for the `metered_text` operator string at 570, and for the numeric log at 578.

The handler saves state through `_save_state(state)` defined at `handler.py:144-145` and called at line 640. The return payload at `handler.py:641-651` carries `day`, `metered_usd`, `metered_status`, `ce_usd`, `ce_status`, `effective_usd`, `effective_source`, `threshold_usd` and `deny_attached` — no estimated-rate field. WARNING notification text is built at the `_notify` call at `handler.py:596-605`; TRIP notification text is built at the `_notify` call at `handler.py:629-638`. Neither message identifies seed or fallback participation.

## Required change

Change `_rate_for()`'s return contract so callers receive both the numeric rate and a bounded source value drawn from `empirical`, `seed`, `empirical_scaled` and `fallback`. Update every caller in this handler in the same patch.

Carry the provenance as a **new field on the existing frozen `MeteredSpend` dataclass**, beside `degraded` and `failures`. Do not reintroduce a bare-float return and do not add a parallel return channel: `cfe0` already established `MeteredSpend` as the single result object for this function, and an `estimated` flag is the same kind of fact as `degraded`. Accumulate it in the same loop that accumulates `total`, setting it when any component's source is `seed` or `fallback`. Preserve the existing numeric behaviour for `empirical` and `empirical_scaled` rates, and preserve the `None` unavailable path unchanged.

Thread the provenance through the handler response payload, the saved SSM state dict, and the WARNING and TRIP `_notify` call sites. Use one field name consistently; `metered_estimated` is acceptable.

Leave the CE-poll gate at line 535 alone. `604c-ade8` removed the unconditional `metered is None` trigger and `cfe0` kept it removed; an estimated-rate flag is not a reason to poll Cost Explorer ahead of `CE_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS`, so `metered_estimated` must not appear as a poll trigger.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `_rate_for()` returns the numeric rate and a bounded source value.
- [x] `_rate_for()` labels exact empirical matches as `empirical`.
- [x] `_rate_for()` labels seed matches as `seed`.
- [x] `_rate_for()` labels input-derived empirical matches as `empirical_scaled`.
- [x] `_rate_for()` labels `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K` fallback matches as `fallback`.
- [x] Every `_rate_for()` call site in `handler.py` is updated to the new return contract.
- [x] `MeteredSpend` carries the estimated-provenance flag as a field alongside `degraded` and `failures`.
- [x] `_metered_spend()` still returns a `MeteredSpend`, not a bare float.
- [x] `_metered_spend()` still returns `None` when a CloudWatch failure prevents a complete scan before any token series contributes.
- [x] `_metered_spend()` accumulates the existing numeric spend total unchanged for `empirical` and `empirical_scaled` sources.
- [x] `_metered_spend()` reports estimated provenance when any component source is `seed`.
- [x] `_metered_spend()` reports estimated provenance when any component source is `fallback`.
- [x] `_metered_spend()` reports estimated provenance as false when every component source is `empirical` or `empirical_scaled`.
- [x] The handler return payload includes `metered_estimated: true` when metered spend includes a seed rate.
- [x] The handler return payload includes `metered_estimated: true` when metered spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [x] The saved SSM state includes `metered_estimated: true` after a run whose metered spend includes a seed rate.
- [x] The saved SSM state includes `metered_estimated: true` after a run whose metered spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [x] WARNING SNS text includes `estimated` when warning spend includes a seed rate.
- [x] TRIP SNS text includes `estimated` when trip spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [x] The CE-poll gate contains no `metered_estimated` trigger.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py -k estimated` exits 0.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py` exits 0.
- [x] CI's gating `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` cell passes on the merged revision, evidenced by `Verified +1` on Gerrit change 3003 at `740983fe830`. [non-codebase] The local `make verify` equivalent is not runnable on this macOS host: `pypandoc-binary==1.17`'s arm64 wheel ships an x86_64 pandoc, failing 17 unrelated tests.

## Testing

During development run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py -k estimated`. Before push run the whole file with `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py`, which also re-runs `cfe0`'s degraded-partial and CE-interval tests and so guards the two behaviours this change sits next to. Before the Gerrit push run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify`.

## Out of scope

Do not change the Claude Marketplace CE service filter in this ticket; `3083-ada3` owns that empirical-rate and authoritative-spend fix. Do not alter the CE polling interval policy or the degraded-meter release guard; `604c-ade8` and `cfe0-4b2b` own those.
